description: This Java class defines an Android Activity named MediaPlayerDemo_Audio which demonstrates how to play audio files using the MediaPlayer API. It handles different sources like local files and resource files, and provides UI feedback via a TextView and Toast messages.

classes.name: MediaPlayerDemo_Audio
classes.description: An Android Activity class that demonstrates audio playback using MediaPlayer, including local and resource-based audio sources.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the TextView, and starts audio playback based on intent extras.

methods.name: playAudio
methods.description: Configures and starts MediaPlayer to play audio from either a local file path or a resource.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases MediaPlayer resources when the activity is destroyed.
